question2_simple_relaxation.proposal_not_implemented: Permit bounded low-confidence interior dropouts only when supplied source+context has complete eligible coverage, exactly one supported speaker/epoch, no competing/overlap evidence, and clear evidence of that same key on both sides within supplied input. Preserve ordinary text and current mixed/uncertain/unavailable outcomes otherwise.
question2_simple_relaxation.complexity: Keep this inside existing whole-input attribution, not a new classifier, majority vote or text splitter. Limit total tolerated dropout with an absolute cap and a cap relative to unique clear same-speaker support; silence or duplicate replay cannot enlarge the allowance. No numerical thresholds or production optimum selected.
question2_simple_relaxation.counterevidence: The reported70ms is10ms onset+50ms fade+10ms trailing boundary, not one interior hole. Last immutable interval[49568,49728) has highest probability in successor slot1 around0.35062; next active/clear evidence is slot1. Thus the exact example must not be silently promoted to A by a blanket70ms allowance.
question2_simple_relaxation.limits: The narrow interior-hole proposal does not color the exact clean-A example. One-sided onset/fade or successor-edge tolerance is a separate material acoustic tradeoff; no automatic broadening until an example becomes colored. ShortNo./numbers retain text even when gray.

question3_later_attribution.current_fact: CausalBatchSession._submit computes attribution and constructs frozen STTSourceAudio together; _consume saves native result and _release reuses the saved attribution. Downstream SourceChild immutability requires final composition before translation, not necessarily before native recognition.
question3_later_attribution.reason_limit: No authoritative author rationale requiring submission-time freeze was found. Simpler snapshot lifetime/less pending-evidence retention is an inference, not a documented requirement.
question3_later_attribution.proposal_not_implemented: Keep source/context ranges, input cursor, native options, identity and display group immutable at submission. Snapshot attribution once on that slice's own native terminal, before contribution release/SourceChild admission, using only already-delivered immutable evidence. No added wait, re-decode, source recut or post-publication recolor.
question3_later_attribution.required_mechanism: Existing shared bounded frame cache must retain unresolved slices' needed source/context footprint until their own final snapshot. Merely moving _attribute is insufficient: current active-payload floor can prune earlier proof after a cut. Preserve hard cache bounds; loss/eviction remains conservative. Reset/epoch/capture fences prevent old source from acquiring a new epoch's equal numeric key. Snapshot on own result, not on later ordered release.
question3_later_attribution.observed_opportunity: Read-only recorded-evidence analysis at each own native result found13 of87 previously positive coverage gaps close;44 remain gaps. No origin becomes fully certain under the unchanged strict rule. Correction example missing10560samples at submit becomes0by result, while cleanB's6464sample gap persists. This is analysis, NOT a changed-runtime execution or guaranteed color improvement.
question3_later_attribution.analysis_limit: Recorded reconstruction does not replay request-specific pruning floor; evidence-delivery timestamps precede awaited engine delivery. Prior local harness used5ms pump while ordinary peer-channel drain is50ms; exact opportunity frequencies must not be generalized to normal startup.
question3_later_attribution.next_bounded_validation: Before implementation acceptance, replay pending retention/frontier/epoch handling over the existing clearAB/correction/shortNo/overlap records. Verify unchanged PCM/source order, exactly one final snapshot, no added wait, preserved uncertain successor edge and no post-release mutation.

cloud_execution_authorization.policy: Task-chosen conservative maximum, not a spending target. Enforce before transmission/start; retain failures. No fallback Gemini key or unbounded retries. Existing local Gemma translates; no other paid LLM, download, private capture or VR workload.
cloud_execution_authorization.evidence_ownership: Cloud execution reports/archives/drivers authored by profile-experiment; Director assessment and independent review are separate. Previous local artifacts remain unchanged.
